risk_if_not_implemented: Without Event Log & Security-Relevant Telemetry Review Escalation Matrix, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), Delayed Containment / Increased Incident Impact (R-IR-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Event Log Review Escalation Matrix (MON-05.3) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize a Security Incident Event Manager (SIEM), or similar automated tool, to support the centralized collection of event logs and security-relevant telemetry.
compensating_control_2.justification: Centralized Collection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry (MON-05) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Event Log Review Escalation Matrix (MON-05.3) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
